gpuProfile.name: blackwell
gpuProfile.rationale: ≥48GB VRAM: VL(8GB)+coder(9GB)+embed(0.3GB) co-resident with ~70GB headroom — extract CONCURRENTLY with the live fleet, no overnight window. Realized ×N inference also needs OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL≥N on the server (each parallel slot adds ~num_ctx of KV-cache); worker concurrency overlaps render/IO regardless.
gpuProfile.summary: catalog-gpu: tier=blackwell (96GB, via nvidia-smi) → qwen3-vl:8b-instruct ×3 workers, concurrent (no overnight gate)

caveat: measuredSerialRate is a THROUGHPUT FLOOR derived from completion-timestamp deltas — it includes per-print IO/model-load/render, not pure GPU inference. The real concurrent speedup is therefore conservative (biased low), never inflated.

projection.note: 3 workers but only 2× inference (OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2); raise the server's parallel slots for the full ×3

note: realized concurrency bounded by OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2 → 2× effective (2× faster than serial on the same workload)
action: LEVER: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2 is below this host's recommended 4 → run `scripts/system-health/05-soft-config-tweaks.ps1` (host-aware, sets 4) and let Ollama restart on the next idle window to unlock up to ×3 inference (currently ×2).
